message.content:
The user now needs to enter the interface to start a conversation, and the previous click on "Start a conversation" has not yet entered the interface. Therefore, it is necessary to click the "Start a conversation" button again. The corresponding element is [286, 168, 711, 227], and the Tap action will be executed. This is to ensure entering the interface for creating a new conversation, so that the phone number can be entered and the message sent.


do(action="Tap", element=[498,205])
